name: 相手の識別名で友だちを追加するフォーム
prompt:
Correct the attached v001 Japanese mobile form to match the native 390 × 722 preview. Treat the native preview as exact ground truth and v001 only as the image to correct. Keep the same clean flat white background and all existing Japanese wording, colors, font sizes and rounded shapes.

v001 places the title about 29 px too high, the input and username note about 34 px too high, and the bottom action about 25 px too high. Move the title down to its native visual position around y=108, the input to x=16,y=150,w=358,h=50, the note to x=16,y=220, and the action down to x=16,y=670,w=358,h=32. Keep the title/input/note gaps close to the preview and preserve the very large blank white area below the note. Keep the input text at x=32,y=163, and center the action label. Do not enlarge the text or scale up the whole form.

Use exactly these strings: 「誰に友だち申請を送りますか？」, 「相手の識別名を入力」, 「あなたの識別名：やまだ・はるか」, 「友だち申請を送信」. Use Meiryo Regular; title 14 px #1D1D1D, input placeholder 14 px #6E6E6E, username note 12 px #6E6E6E, white action label 12 px. Keep the input #ECFDF5 and action #047857.

The username note is neutral text in the native component, not a hyperlink. Do not color it blue or underline it. If a true hyperlink appears, color only the hyperlink text blue #1976D2. Do not add icons, cards, helper text, extra controls, device chrome, texture, gradients or other decoration.
reviewNotes: v002 preserves the exact form content and native colors. Residuals: title remains about 29px too high, input/note about 33-35px high, bottom action about 21px high, and form text slightly smaller than native. Native node has no hyperlink (link=null); keep this component needs-correction after two attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
